lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase CaCdS₂ (space group I4/m, No. 38) has a unit cell containing eight atoms—Ca₂Cd₂S₄—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd centers in tetrahedral S coordination and Ca centers with eight S neighbors, while each S center has three geometric neighbors (one Ca, two Cd). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Cd tetrahedra and both corner- and face-sharing between Ca 8-vertex polyhedra.
